backend/main.mo: Implements user profile and product storage with access‑controlled queries and updates for profiles, product definitions, and metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature reports linking product requirements to frontend files, components, and tests for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of all frontend files for reference or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading jsPDF and JSZip from CDNs and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing authentication, profile setup, view switching, and bundle generation flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling authentication state and query cache resets.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first‑time users to submit a name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Displays generated product bundles with previews and provides download actions for PDFs, ZIPs, and all‑products ZIP.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main layout with header, footer, authentication status, and wrapper for page content.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Displays an iframe preview of a generated PDF or an alert when no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Shows a scrollable list of files that will be included in the product’s ZIP bundle based on its content.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Interactive editor for configuring a product’s fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with generate action.
Manages multiple product drafts, autosaves them, and triggers generation of single or all product bundles.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login/logout handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines queries and mutations for loading and saving the caller’s user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to generated cover image paths and provides helpers to resolve and fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility functions to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates sanitized, date/version-based filenames for product PDFs and ZIPs.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Loops through products to generate bundles sequentially with optional progress reporting.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a full product bundle by generating its PDF, creating a ZIP, and returning metadata.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages localStorage persistence for product drafts with versioning and error handling.
Creates a PDF document for a product using jsPDF, including cover, details, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Creates a master ZIP containing each product’s ZIP and a generated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product containing the PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and a README.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and react-query providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript types for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL/session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, features, requirements, and image needs.
